dialogue_text: Clinician: How are you feeling about adding more walking to your routine? Patient: I actually bought walking shoes last weekend. I keep thinking I should start, but my knee sometimes aches after a long day, and I don’t want to make it worse. Clinician: What would help you feel comfortable deciding what to try? Patient: I guess I’d like to know how to start without overdoing it.
intent_labels: Expressing interest in increasing physical activity
Seeking guidance on a cautious starting approach
